questions.question: You added `fundsApi.reducer` to configureStore but not `fundsApi.middleware`. What is the likely result?
options: Nothing changes; the middleware is optional
Caching features such as subscriptions, refetching and cache expiry do not work correctly
questions.explanation: The API middleware manages subscriptions, cache lifetimes and refetching. Without it, RTK Query's core caching behaviour breaks, so it must be concatenated to getDefaultMiddleware().

questions.question: A list has already loaded once. The user clicks Refresh. What are isLoading and isFetching while the refetch is in flight?
questions.explanation: isLoading is only true for the first load when there is no data. isFetching is true for any in-flight request, including refetches, while the old data stays available.

questions.question: Two components on the same page both call `useGetFundQuery(1)`. How many network requests does RTK Query send?
options: One, because both subscribe to the same cache entry
Zero until one of them calls refetch
It depends on whether React StrictMode is enabled
questions.explanation: Cache entries are keyed by endpoint and argument. Both components subscribe to getFund(1), and RTK Query de-duplicates the request.

questions.question: What does keepUnusedDataFor control?
options: How long a request may take before it times out
How often a query is polled
How many cache entries an endpoint can hold
How many seconds cached data is kept after its last subscriber unsubscribes (default 60)
questions.explanation: When no component is subscribed to an entry, RTK Query waits keepUnusedDataFor seconds (60 by default) before removing it, so a quick remount is served from cache.
